CustomField.description: User tier (1-6) used to look up this line's list price in the Beacon Tier Price table. Tier 1 = 1-3 users, 2 = 4-5, 3 = 6-10, 4 = 11-20, 5 = 21-50, 6 = 51 or more. It is based on Pricing Users: this line's users on Per Module price books, or the quote's highest users on Module Count price books.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Pricing_Users__c), NULL, IF(Pricing_Users__c <= 3, 1, IF(Pricing_Users__c <= 5, 2, IF(Pricing_Users__c <= 10, 3, IF(Pricing_Users__c <= 20, 4, IF(Pricing_Users__c <= 50, 5, 6))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 1 = 1-3 users, 2 = 4-5, 3 = 6-10, 4 = 11-20, 5 = 21-50, 6 = 51+. Module Count price books use the highest users on the quote.
CustomField.label: User Tier
